name: team_planning_close_step
description: Close a step of a Team Planning plan once its period has ended, the step taken on the timeline. Steps close in timeline order, from the day after the step's last day; a step with no end date, the baseline and an alternative another step closed in place of can't close. Once closed, the step and the alternatives it wasn't taken over can't change, and the steps after it stand on the organisation as the Org Graph holds it the day after the step ends, with every change the closed steps planned that hadn't happened by then carried over. team_planning_reopen_step undoes it. Refused, naming why, unless the caller is an editor.
